title: Weird Little game Claude developed when left to autonomously develop a game for over 24 hours
author: RetconnedUsername
selftext:
Gave it a very basic outline for the game

gave it a file with a development loop and gave it the goal to repeat it until asked to stop.

[https://itch.io/game/edit/4677898](https://itch.io/game/edit/4677898)

The visuals are atrocious as you can see in the screenshot, but it's kinda cool

comments.author: RetconnedUsername
comments.body: Bought the 20x plan for fable 5 so now that its restricted i have way more credits than i can use for my actual projects. I'm going to leave it running all week

comments.author: Early_Situation_6552
comments.body: howd you get it to run for 24 hours? what was it working based off of?

replies.author: RetconnedUsername
replies.body:
you have to use /goal

tell it to re read the file are every loop

this is the autodev file [https://pastebin.com/fPWcKdvB](https://pastebin.com/fPWcKdvB)

replies.author: Early_Situation_6552
replies.body: very nice. so you used this + a GDD?

replies.author: RetconnedUsername
replies.body: i only ever gave it a very basic outline and the autodev file it created everything else itself

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: That is wild. How many lines of code did it create?

replies.author: RetconnedUsername
replies.body: i dont know how to see in total, but it hasn't used very good coding practices the [NPC.gd](http://NPC.gd) file is one monolithic 4000 line file

comments.author: miomao10
comments.body: Maybe give the ai more structure or something to capture some sort of element or replicate some game workd

replies.author: RetconnedUsername
replies.body: nah, I've already got structured project im working on. this is just to see what it does autonomously

replies.author: RetconnedUsername
replies.body: it made some of them itself, i think programmatically. the rest are kenney.nl assets it asked to download.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: Fable is wild. I wish I have access to Fable.
